appended.name: ITV plc
appended.suggestion: For new strong-buy names with a live regulatory deal and a just-launched buyback, emit watch items (CMA/Ofcom decision, close/break date, cash-return circular, next trading update, 2026 notes) rather than only lowering conviction_score.

appended.name: ITV plc
appended.suggestion: Filings-first order is adequate when the live issue is annual/interim numbers, and this pack has 17 annual + 6 interim bodies. It is not adequate when the live issue is a transformative M&A RNS filed as period=other/priority=0: the 6 July 2026 Sky M&E sale sits below trading_update, Yahoo, and news on the assignment path. Trading updates are first-class in the index summary but outside the annual/interim rule. alternate_news is a dead step while news_manifest is populated (89 RSS-heavy items). yahoo_quarterly_cashflow is on the ladder but empty, so intra-year FCF cannot be checked except via filings.

appended.name: ITV plc
appended.suggestion: Four worker types plus a five-task cap force annual + interim + news + screen + gap and leave no slot for the Sky sale body (10f52d865099383d), Q1 2026 trading update, 31 July buyback RNS, or 2026/2032 notes consent pack. Naive first/last-of-period selection would assign Directorate Change or Share Repurchase (both tagged annual) or IR FY decks tagged interim. No task type exists to reconcile screen/Yahoo FCF bases or to mark continuing versus discontinued perimeter.

appended.name: ITV plc
appended.suggestion: The screen still emits strong_buy on the pre-deal consolidated group (advertising yield, company-adjusted FCF, P/E 11.6) after a announced carve-out that changes the equity’s cash-flow identity. Overlays that should have fired did not: fcf_basis_overlay=false despite filing £148m vs TTM £212m vs adj £187m; cyclical_exposure_detected=false on an ad-funded broadcaster; interim_quality_overlay=false despite H1 existing and Yahoo quarterly statements empty. Dividend-family pass versus filing FCF cover below 1.0× is the same scoring tension seen on MEGP, now compounded by a perimeter change the director prompt does not force workers to split.

appended.name: ITV plc
appended.suggestion: A new one-week strong_buy with a live CMA/Ofcom deal, a just-started buyback, 2026 notes outstanding, and no post-H1 trading update has no watch schema (deal close/break, cash-return mechanics, next TU, dividend rebase to stub). Conviction_score=0.53 is not a substitute for those monitors.

appended.name: ITV plc
appended.suggestion: A generic FINANCIAL REVIEW / RISKS split will blend continuing Studios with discontinued M&E and will not force a CORPORATE ACTIONS / perimeter section. Without an explicit continuing-vs-consolidated rule, workers can cite FY25 group yield and H1 TAR growth as if they persist post-close. No required slot for regulatory-deal conditions or notes-consent residual risk.
